measurement.latency: Browser-owned readiness observer starts at UI postMessage/input capture; matching rendered DOM followed by two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; driver evaluation only awaits the existing completion promise; excludes Playwright input delivery
measurement.readiness: Navigation matches actual page data-mode; search matches input value and visible repository identities. Five-second timeout; observers and pending animation frames are cleaned up on completion, timeout or supersession.
measurement.memory: Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage at primed, navigation-complete and search-complete checkpoints; parent plus both same-origin Webviews
measurement.scope: VSIX packaged assets + isolated mock host UI; no real GitLab, VS Code Extension Host, Git operations or Codex

firstFeedback.timing: DOM click capture before the UI handler to matching selection, disabled control or visible progress followed by one requestAnimationFrame; scripted DOM activation, excludes native input delivery
firstFeedback.completion: Separately measured event-to-mock-host completion. Artificial host delay is not network or Git performance.
